csit_2026.note: Core Skills Income Threshold, effective 1 July 2026. Applies to Skills in Demand visa (subclass 482) Core Skills stream, and Employer Nomination Scheme (subclass 186). Indexed annually under Regulation 5.42A of the Migration Regulations 1994, based on November ABS Average Weekly Ordinary Time Earnings (AWOTE) data. TSMIT (Temporary Skilled Migration Income Threshold) numerically aligns with CSIT for 2026-27 but is legally a distinct mechanism that does not automatically index the same way — flagged as a genuine legal nuance, not an error, if the two figures diverge in a future year.

ssit_2026.note: Specialist Skills Income Threshold, effective 1 July 2026. Applies to Skills in Demand visa (subclass 482) Specialist Skills stream.
